title: Agape 30A | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: WaterColor retreat with Beach Club access, golf cart, bikes, and a fenced yard—steps from Camp WaterColor and minutes to Seaside and the beach.
description_expanded: Agape 30A Family-Friendly Luxury Steps from Camp WaterColor Home Introduction Unwind in style at Agape 30A , a beautifully designed 3BR/3.5BA retreat in the heart of WaterColor. With a complimentary 6-seater golf cart, bikes, and inviting outdoor living spaces, this home offers effortless access to pools, shopping, and the Beach Club-making it the perfect 30A escape for families and friends. Home Highlights Complimentary 6-Seater LSV Golf Cart - Included with stay (waiver required) 4 Taxi Bikes - Regularly serviced for your adventures Pet Friendly - Pre-approval plus fee required for up to 2 dogs (60 pounds or less per dog) Outdoor Living - Rocking-chair front porch, side patio with grill & dining, fenced backyard Sleeping for 8 Guests - 2 King suites + bunk suite for 4 Spacious Main Living Area with SmartTV Full Kitchen with stainless appliances, breakfast bar for 4, and dining for 8 First-Floor King Suite - Ideal for grandparents or early risers Laundry Room on Main Level with washer & dryer Pocket Park Views - More greenspace right outside the front door Access to WaterColor Beach Club, Camp WaterColor, and community pools (heated seasonally) for up to 8 guests Driveway parking for 3 vehicles Complete Clean Linen Program - All linens laundered after every stay Concierge services available: grocery delivery, baby gear rentals, chef services, beach bonfires Location Perks 2 blocks to Camp WaterColor with pools, lazy river, and dining 6-min LSV/bike ride to WaterColor Beach Club (beach service available) 2-min LSV/bike ride to Publix, Pizza by the Sea, The Perfect Pig, and boutique shopping Overlooks a peaceful pocket park for added greenspace Know Before You Go A mid-stay clean is required for reservations of 10+ days (included in rate) Access to WaterColor amenities included for 8 guests Towel service at Camp WaterColor and Beach Club subject to neighborhood policies Concierge available for add-ons such as eBikes, private chef, and beach chair setups ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***

2nd Floor Bunk Suite | Sleeps up to 4 in a Twin over King Bunk plus Twin Trundle, TV, reach-in closet storage, ensuite bath with combo shower/tub
